description: Repair route_record(record) to apply the specified precedence and severity rules when selecting a document-processing route.
requirements: Return a dict with exactly route and reasons keys, with reasons always a list. Do not mutate the input.
First, a status other than 'ok' means route 'failed' and reasons [status]. Missing status defaults to 'ok'. This takes precedence over every other field.
Next, processable=False means route 'skip' and reasons []; processable defaults True. Next, is_target_type=False also means 'skip' and reasons []. These skip routes ignore flags.
Next, missing or None is_target_type means route 'review' and reasons ['UNCLASSIFIED'], regardless of flags. Valid classification values are True, False and None.

For a processable target, only severity exactly 'ERROR' gates review. WARN or missing severity does not. Collect error codes in first-occurrence order with duplicates removed; missing, None or empty code becomes 'UNKNOWN_ERROR'.
If error codes exist return 'review' with those reasons; otherwise return 'auto' with reasons []. Missing or None flags means no flags.

provenance.description: The routing vocabulary is inspired by document-extraction validation concerns. The branch precedence and all fixture code/tests are original constructed calibration material, not historical task data.

validity_limits: Calibration only; these tasks do not establish representative development performance or generality.
Hidden tests are independent of the solving run, not independently authored from this fixture's reference implementation.
The oracle is one valid implementation, not an exact patch requirement; behavioral alternatives are allowed.
Passing visible tests is intentionally insufficient. Base failure is seeded and does not predict model failure rate.
